title: Tenant Capability Registry
purpose: Tenant-safe capability map for Tenant GPT guidance. This is read-only guidance and does not grant permissions.

capabilities.guidance: Use at session start. Managed mode is the default unless the tenant asks for dedicated infrastructure.
Read once per session when available so the GPT can guide proactively from live tenant-safe docs.
Use read-only workspace tools before member or invitation mutations. Owner/admin role may be required.
Use secure intake links for credentials. Never ask for secrets in chat.
Check connect_status first. Do not reinstall when an enabled registered device already exists unless the user asks.
Status/preflight/probe are safe read-only checks. Command execution must be allowlisted and approval-gated.
Prefer schema read before read-only queries. Never run broad or secret-bearing queries.
Use available tenant-safe CMS/status tools when discovered. If status tools fail with platform schema/collation errors, classify validation as platform-gated rather than credential failure.
Use for guided checkpointing and user-facing progress maps when available.

status_semantics.status_active: Connection record exists and tenant-scoped credentials are present.
status_semantics.validation_pending: Live verification is incomplete, blocked, or not yet promoted.
status_semantics.fully_validated: Only claim after same-cycle tenant-safe live validation or explicit platform validation status update.

default_next_best_actions: Run the safest read-only status or preflight tool.
Explain what is proven and what remains blocked.
